key_insight: VQE ansatz selection trades accuracy for hardware cost: ADAPT-VQE approaches UCCSD accuracy with lower resource overhead, while hardware-efficient ansätze sacrifice accuracy.
engineering_relevance: Near-term electronic-structure workflows must balance circuit depth, parameter count, and optimization difficulty rather than choose an ansatz on accuracy alone.
method: Compare UCCSD, fermionic ADAPT-VQE, BasicPCA HEA, and Excitation Preserving HEA.
Benchmark electronic-structure calculations for H₂, LiH, and N₂.
Evaluate ground-state energy error, circuit depth, parameter count, and NISQ feasibility.
evidence_signal: Across the tested molecules, ADAPT-VQE achieves accuracy comparable to UCCSD, while hardware-efficient ansatz performance depends strongly on molecular size.
watch_item: ADAPT-VQE becomes impractical around 10 electrons as circuit complexity grows, limiting its scalability despite favorable accuracy.
paper_title: A Unified Benchmarking Study of Variational Quantum Eigensolver Ansatz for Electronic Structure Problems
